# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independently written, pre-content isolated tool bootstrap.
import sys
START_PATH = tuple(sys.path)
EVENTS = {"write_attempts": 0, "network_attempts": 0, "process_attempts": 0,
          "cache_write_attempts": 0, "native_requests": 0, "optional_requests": 0}
PHASE = "stdlib"
ALLOWED_PRIVATE = None
def audit(event, args):
    if event == "open":
        name, mode, flags = args
        writing = (isinstance(mode, str) and any(c in mode for c in "wax+")) or (isinstance(flags, int) and flags & 3 != 0) or (isinstance(flags, int) and flags & (64|512|1024))
        if writing:
            EVENTS["write_attempts"] += 1
            if str(name).endswith(".pyc"): EVENTS["cache_write_attempts"] += 1
            raise RuntimeError("filesystem write refused")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not (name.startswith("/usr/lib/") or name.startswith("/usr/local/lib/") or name == sys.executable or name == "/proc/self/maps" or name == ALLOWED_PRIVATE):
            raise RuntimeError("unexpected read refused")
        if ("/capstone/" in name or "/elftools/" in name) and name.endswith(".pyc"):
            raise RuntimeError("decoder bytecode refused")
    if event.startswith(("socket.", "urllib.", "http.")):
        EVENTS["network_attempts"] += 1
        raise RuntimeError("network refused")
    if event.startswith(("subprocess.", "os.system", "os.exec", "os.spawn", "os.fork")):
        EVENTS["process_attempts"] += 1
        raise RuntimeError("process refused")
    if event in ("os.remove","os.rename","os.mkdir","os.rmdir","os.chmod","os.chown","os.truncate","os.link","os.symlink","os.utime"):
        EVENTS["write_attempts"] += 1
        raise RuntimeError("filesystem mutation refused")
    if event == "ctypes.dlopen" and PHASE != "stdlib":
        if PHASE != "decoder" or args != (NATIVE_PATH,) or EVENTS["native_requests"] != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("native discovery refused")
    if event == "import" and PHASE == "sealed":
        if args[0] == "ccapstone" or args[0].split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools"):
            raise RuntimeError("post-boundary decoder import refused")
sys.addaudithook(audit)
import os, stat, pathlib, hashlib, json, csv, io, base64, struct, ast, marshal, ctypes
import sysconfig, importlib.metadata, importlib.abc, importlib.util
def require(ok, message):
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(message)
def identity(path):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    s = p.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink(), "nonregular or symlink component")
    require(p.is_absolute() and str(p.resolve()) == str(p), "noncanonical component")
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(p), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), "size": len(b),
            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), "mtime_ns": s.st_mtime_ns}
def forbidden_loaded():
    return [n for n in sys.modules if n in ("site","sitecustomize","usercustomize","ccapstone") or n.split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools")]
require(sys.flags.isolated == 1 and sys.flags.no_site == 1 and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode == 1, "nonisolated startup")
require(sys.version_info[:3] == (3,12,3), "interpreter version")
require(not forbidden_loaded(), "forbidden initial module")
INTERPRETER = identity(sys.executable)
ROOTS = sorted(set([sysconfig.get_path("purelib"),sysconfig.get_path("platlib"),"/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages"]))
require(all(p.startswith(("/usr/lib/","/usr/local/lib/")) for p in ROOTS), "distribution root outside installed environment")
RECORDS, SOURCES, MODULES, EXECUTED = {}, {}, {}, []
DISTRIBUTIONS = {}
def discover(distribution_name, package, version):
    ds = [d for d in importlib.metadata.distributions(path=ROOTS) if d.metadata["Name"].lower().replace("-","_") == distribution_name.lower().replace("-","_")]
    require(len(ds) == 1, "distribution count: " + distribution_name)
    d = ds[0]
    require(d.version == version, "distribution version: " + distribution_name)
    root = pathlib.Path(d.locate_file("")).resolve()
    require(str(root) in ROOTS, "distribution root")
    files = d.files
    require(files is not None, "missing distribution file inventory: " + distribution_name)
    rec = [f for f in files if str(f).endswith(".dist-info/RECORD")]
    require(len(rec) == 1, "missing or ambiguous RECORD: " + distribution_name)
    rp = pathlib.Path(d.locate_file(rec[0]))
    RECORDS[distribution_name] = identity(rp)
    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(rp.read_text())))
    seen = set()
    for row in rows:
        require(len(row) == 3, "malformed RECORD")
        name,digest,size = row
        require(name not in seen, "duplicate RECORD origin")
        seen.add(name)
        if not name.startswith(package + "/") or not name.endswith(".py"): continue
        require(not pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute() and ".." not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts, "source path escape")
        p = root / name
        ident = identity(p)
        require(digest.startswith("sha256=") and size.isdecimal(), "missing RECORD digest or size")
        expected = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(digest[7:] + "===")
        require(expected.hex() == ident["sha256"] and int(size) == ident["size"], "RECORD source mismatch")
        module = name[:-3].replace("/",".")
        is_package = module.endswith(".__init__")
        if is_package: module = module[:-9]
        require(module not in MODULES, "duplicate module origin")
        MODULES[module] = {"identity":ident,"package":is_package}
        SOURCES[module] = p.read_bytes()
    require(package in MODULES, "missing package source")
    DISTRIBUTIONS[distribution_name] = {"version":version,"root":str(root)}
def maps():
    result = {}
    for line in pathlib.Path("/proc/self/maps").read_text().splitlines():
        fields = line.split(maxsplit=5)
        require(len(fields) >= 5, "malformed native map")
        perms = fields[1]
        name = fields[5] if len(fields)==6 else ""
        if not name or name.startswith("["):
            require("x" not in perms, "anonymous or pseudo-file executable mapping")
            continue
        require(name.startswith("/") and not name.endswith(" (deleted)"), "unresolved native mapping")
        result[name] = identity(name)
    require(len(result) <= 128, "native component cap")
    return result
def needed(path):
    b = pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()
    require(b[:6] == b"\x7fELF\x02\x01", "native ELF format")
    h = struct.unpack_from("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH",b)
    phoff,phsize,phnum = h[5],h[9],h[10]
    require(h[2] == 183 and phsize == 56, "native ELF machine or phentsize")
    ph = [struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ",b,phoff+i*phsize) for i in range(phnum)]
    dyn = [p for p in ph if p[0] == 2]
    require(len(dyn)==1, "native dynamic table count")
    p=dyn[0]; require(p[2]+p[5]<=len(b) and p[5]%16==0,"native dynamic bounds")
    entries=[]
    for off in range(p[2],p[2]+p[5],16):
        t,v=struct.unpack_from("<qQ",b,off)
        if t==0: break
        entries.append((t,v))
    else: raise RuntimeError("unterminated native dynamic table")
    tables=[v for t,v in entries if t==5]; sizes=[v for t,v in entries if t==10]
    require(len(tables)==len(sizes)==1,"native string table")
    va,sz=tables[0],sizes[0]
    loads=[p for p in ph if p[0]==1 and p[3]<=va and va+sz<=p[3]+p[5]]
    require(len(loads)==1,"native string mapping")
    off=loads[0][2]+va-loads[0][3]; strings=b[off:off+sz]; names=[]
    for t,v in entries:
        if t!=1: continue
        end=strings.find(b"\0",v)
        require(0<=v<end<len(strings),"native dependency string")
        names.append(strings[v:end].decode("ascii"))
    return names
class SourceLoader(importlib.abc.Loader):
    def create_module(self,spec): return None
    def exec_module(self,module):
        name=module.__name__
        require(name in MODULES and len(EXECUTED)<64,"module map or cap")
        item=MODULES[name]; path=item["identity"]["path"]
        require(identity(path)==item["identity"],"source drift")
        code=compile(SOURCES[name],path,"exec",dont_inherit=True,optimize=0)
        EXECUTED.append({"module":name,"source":item["identity"],"code_sha256":hashlib.sha256(marshal.dumps(code)).hexdigest()})
        module.__file__=path
        if item["package"]: module.__path__=[]
        exec(code,module.__dict__)
class TerminalFinder(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self,fullname,path=None,target=None):
        if fullname=="ccapstone":
            EVENTS["optional_requests"]+=1
            raise ImportError("optional decoder explicitly refused")
        if fullname.split(".")[0] in ("capstone","elftools"):
            require(PHASE=="decoder" and fullname in MODULES,"unmapped or late decoder import")
            return importlib.util.spec_from_loader(fullname,SourceLoader(),is_package=MODULES[fullname]["package"])
        return None
def main():
    global PHASE,NATIVE_PATH
    discover("capstone","capstone","4.0.2")
    discover("pyelftools","elftools","0.30")
    # The exact verified source is the sole static callsite evidence.
    tree=ast.parse(SOURCES["capstone"])
    loads=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and ast.unparse(n.func)=="ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary"]
    require(len(loads)==1 and len(loads[0].args)==1 and isinstance(loads[0].args[0],ast.Constant) and loads[0].args[0].value=="libcapstone.so.4","native callsite ambiguity")
    opts=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Import) and any(a.name=="ccapstone" for a in n.names)]
    require(len(opts)==1,"optional callsite count")
    guards=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Try) and opts[0] in [x for a in n.body for x in ast.walk(a)]]
    require(len(guards)==1 and len(guards[0].handlers)==1 and guards[0].handlers[0].type is None and all(isinstance(n,ast.Pass) for n in guards[0].handlers[0].body),"optional refusal fallback unproved")
    NATIVE_PATH="/usr/lib/"+sysconfig.get_config_var("MULTIARCH")+"/libcapstone.so.4"
    primary=identity(NATIVE_PATH)
    dependencies=needed(NATIVE_PATH)
    baseline=maps()
    original=ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary
    def exact(name):
        require(name=="libcapstone.so.4" and EVENTS["native_requests"]==0,"unexpected native request")
        EVENTS["native_requests"]+=1
        return original(NATIVE_PATH)
    finder=TerminalFinder()
    ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary=exact
    sys.meta_path.insert(0,finder)
    PHASE="decoder"
    import capstone
    from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
    engine=capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64,capstone.CS_MODE_LITTLE_ENDIAN)
    engine.detail=True
    require(EVENTS["native_requests"]==EVENTS["optional_requests"]==1,"load route count drift")
    after=maps()
    require(all(after.get(k)==v for k,v in baseline.items()),"baseline mapping drift")
    require(NATIVE_PATH in after,"missing primary mapping")
    closure={}
    for name in dependencies:
        hits=[p for p in after if pathlib.Path(p).name==name]
        require(len(hits)==1,"unaccounted or ambiguous DT_NEEDED")
        closure[name]=hits[0]
    new=set(after)-set(baseline)
    require(new <= set(closure.values())|{NATIVE_PATH},"additional native component")
    ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary=original
    sys.meta_path.remove(finder)
    sys.path[:]=START_PATH
    PHASE="sealed"
    require(ctypes.cdll.LoadLibrary is original and finder not in sys.meta_path and tuple(sys.path)==START_PATH,"named restoration")
    require(not any(n in sys.modules for n in ("site","sitecustomize","usercustomize","ccapstone")),"forbidden final module")
    require(all(EVENTS[k]==0 for k in ("write_attempts","cache_write_attempts","network_attempts","process_attempts")),"guard attempt")
    require(identity(sys.executable)==INTERPRETER and all(identity(v["identity"]["path"])==v["identity"] for v in MODULES.values()) and all(identity(p)==v for p,v in after.items()),"final component drift")
    return {"status":"tools-preflight-only","interpreter":INTERPRETER,"distributions":DISTRIBUTIONS,"records":RECORDS,"executed":EXECUTED,"baseline":baseline,"new_native":{p:after[p] for p in sorted(new)},"primary":primary,"needed":closure,"events":EVENTS,"native_version":capstone.cs_version(),"callsite_lines":{"native":loads[0].lineno,"optional":opts[0].lineno},"private_reads":0}
try:
    RECEIPT=main()
    print(json.dumps(RECEIPT,sort_keys=True))
except Exception as exc:
    print(json.dumps({"status":"refused","reason":str(exc),"type":type(exc).__name__,"events":EVENTS,"decoder_modules_executed":len(EXECUTED),"private_reads":0},sort_keys=True))
    raise SystemExit(2)
